newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's CGEM business group reappoints president.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's CGEM business group reappoints president.

text.p: Morocco's CGEM business confederation on Thursday reappointed wealthy businessman Abderrahim Lahjouji as president, a spokesman said.

"Lahjouji, who was the only candidate, was reappointed for three years by a majority of 430 votes, while 30 members abstained," said the spokesman for the Confederation Generale des Entreprises du Maroc (CGEM).
Lahjouji, 55, is also the managing-director of SOTRAVO, a leading contruction firm in Morocco.
